learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn how to start and end our sentences like grammar superstars!
warm_up_hook: 📖 Imagine a toy train that never stops! It would bump into a wall, right? Sentences are like trains. They need a big engine at the start and a red signal to stop at the end. Let us learn about them! 🚂

lesson_modules.teaching_content: Every sentence must start with a big Capital Letter. The Big Letter is like the boss! It pulls all the other small letters behind it.
A sentence cannot run forever. It needs to stop and rest. We put a tiny dot at the very end. This dot is called a Full Stop!
Did you know your name is very special? All special names always start with a big Capital Letter. Even the name of your pet or your city starts with a Big Letter!

practice_quiz.question: ❓ What do we put at the very end of a sentence?

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Magic Colour Game!
fun_activity.instructions: Write your name and a sentence about yourself on a paper. Use a red crayon for the starting Capital Letter and a blue crayon for the Full Stop!

chapter_summary: ⭐ Always start your sentence with a big Capital Letter.
⭐ Always end your sentence with a tiny Full Stop dot.
⭐ Your beautiful special name always gets a Capital Letter!
